sentences.text: The Petitioners are also concerned about release of the vehicles in which the material was being transported.

2. During the analysis of the relevant provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and upon hearing the learned counsel for the parties, we find that the action undertaken by the concerned Authorities under the said Act, may eventually lead to criminal prosecution of the Petitioners in terms of the provisions of the said Act.

3. Even before analyzing as to whether the requirements of Section 42 and other provisions of the said Act have been complied with or not, a fundamental question that arises for consideration is, as to whether the present Writ Petitions filed on the civil side can at all be entertained.

4. We are of the opinion that since the actions undertaken by the Respondents may eventually lead to criminal prosecution of 2 of 3 (( 3 )) 924-WP-8575-2025++ the Petitioners, these Writ Petitions should have been filed on the criminal side.

5. At this Stage, the learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that this Court may permit these Writ Petitions to be converted into Writ Petitions on the criminal side, so as to pursue further remedies in accordance with law.
6. Considering the provisions of the said Act and the nature of issues arising in these Petitions, we are inclined to grant the prayer made on behalf of the Petitioners.
7. In view of the above, the Petitioners are granted time of two weeks to convert these Writ Petitions into Writ Petitions on the criminal side, to be placed before the appropriate Bench.
8. The Respondents are granted liberty to place on record additional affidavits to assist the appropriate Bench, within a period of two weeks from today.
